Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Kunal - 11 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Sonali - 35 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Savitri - 68 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Sonali stands near him.]

Kunal: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Kunal sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Kunal (gently): "Hey, look at that!"

[Kunal mops the floor.]

Sonali: "That was fun!"

[Kunal irons his school shirt.]

Sonali (excited): "Kunal, listen!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Sonali and Savitri stand near him.]

Sonali: "Mother, look over here."

[Kunal hugs Mother tightly.]

Kunal: "How beautiful!"

[Kunal shakes his head.]

Sonali (laughing): "Let's see."

[Kunal gives Mother a flower.]

Savitri: "What happened?"

Scene 3: The snowy hillside - Day

[Kunal stands in the snow. Sonali and Savitri stand near him.]

Kunal: "Let's begin."

[Kunal makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Kunal: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Kunal builds a snowman.]

Kunal: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Kunal slides down the snowy slope.]

Kunal: "That was such a fun day!"
